premises.text: Managing community organizations is challenging without a unified platform.
premises.evidence_span: managing those organizations has been incredibly challenging. I've had to use five platforms to stay organized.

premises.text: Community organizers need a single solution for engagement.
premises.evidence_span: Cohort connects community. What I mean by that, it is the single solution that an organizer needs to engage their membership.

premises.text: Cohort provides integrated tools for communication, events, member management, and transactions.
premises.evidence_span: Communication management, event management, member management, transaction management under one umbrella.

premises.text: Groups can manage hierarchical structures and subgroups online.
premises.evidence_span: Each group can have as many subgroups as they want and as many tiers of subgroups as they need.

premises.text: Cohort allows for social interaction among members through channels.
premises.evidence_span: We've also created something new called channels. Channels are a curated list of groups for a given interest topic.

premises.text: Cohort offers a free service for most groups while generating revenue through subscriptions and transaction fees.
premises.evidence_span: for the vast majority of groups, it's entirely free. We generate revenue by selling subscriptions against our channels and free groups.

premises.text: There is significant interest in Cohort, as evidenced by sign-ups and partnerships.
premises.evidence_span: well over 10,000 people signed up. Today, we're very excited to unveil our company and enter into a private beta with a number of marquee organizations already joining the platform.

value.text: Cohort enables effective community engagement and management.

notes: No traction metrics or external partnerships coded as separate premises.
